mechanism: NSAIDs like meloxicam may reduce the efficacy of levodopa by inhibiting prostaglandin-mediated dopamine release and can increase levodopa levels through reduced renal clearance, while NSAIDs also increase risk of GI bleeding in Parkinson's patients who often have dysphagia and altered GI motility.
action: Monitor for reduced antiparkinsonian efficacy and GI symptoms; consider alternative analgesic such as acetaminophen; maintain adequate hydration and monitor renal function periodically.
